brands.evidence: Yes, Monzo is safe, and your money is protected if the bank were to go bust.

client_claims.text: Eligible deposits are protected by the FSCS up to £85,000 per person.
client_claims.note: Fact says the FSCS limit is £120,000 per person, not £85,000.

client_claims.text: Joint accounts are protected up to £170,000 (£85,000 per account holder).
client_claims.note: Based on the £85,000 limit; the fact gives £120,000 per person.

client_claims.text: Monzo Bank Limited is authorised by the PRA and regulated by both the FCA and the PRA.
Monzo is a fully licensed UK bank (not just an e-money institution or payment app).
client_claims.note: Consistent with Monzo being a UK bank authorised by the PRA.

client_claims.text: Monzo offers savings pots provided by partner banks such as OakNorth, Shawbrook, Charter Savings Bank.
Monzo savings pots with partner banks are covered by the FSCS up to £85,000.
client_claims.note: The fact gives a £120,000 FSCS limit.

client_claims.text: Balances over £85,000 in Monzo deposits are not guaranteed by the FSCS.
Monzo is signed up to the UK's mandatory APP scam reimbursement rules.
You can instantly freeze/unfreeze your card, block gambling transactions, and set up biometrics in the Monzo app.
Monzo Investments holds money in funds (e.g. via BlackRock).
The FSCS typically pays back within a few days if Monzo fails.
